about: A simple, friendly date and time package for Go.

prs.title: Persian dates from March 2025 are no longer a day ahead
prs.broken: The library used a formula that picked the wrong Persian leap year, so every date from March 2025 to March 2026 came out one day ahead.
prs.changed: Year starts now follow the 33-year cycle used by the Persian calendar, with the known break years.
prs.matters: Persian dates are right for the current year, and matched another calendar library daily from 1800 to 2255.
